Original: <@RL,2A,00>メイド少女 いいよね<CF><D1><@RL,40,00>ガ-ルフレンドに するなら<CD>あんなコ だよね<CF><D1><@RL,2A,00>でも メイド少女には ともに<CD>たたかう パ-トナ-が いるらしい<CF><D1><@RL,40,00>ぐっ...男のカゲが...<CF><D1><@RL,2A,00>いや それが 女の子らしい<CF><D1><@RL,40,00>.........<CF><D1><@RL,2A,00>.........<CF><D1><@RL,40,00>まぁ しゅみは ひとそれぞれだし<CF><D1><@RL,2A,00>そうだね
Translated: <@RL,2A,00>Maids are pretty great, huh?<CF><D1><@RL,40,00>If you were picking a girlfriend,<D3>you would want a girl like that, right?<CF><D1><@RL,2A,00>But apparently the maid girl has a<D3>partner who fights alongside her.<CF><D1><@RL,40,00>Guh... So there is a guy...<CF><D1><@RL,2A,00>No, apparently it is a girl.<CF><D1><@RL,40,00>.........<CF><D1><@RL,2A,00>.........<CF><D1><@RL,40,00>Well, everyone has their own tastes.<CF><D1><@RL,2A,00>Yeah.

Original: <@RL,35,00>そこの 2人さ<CD>入学した時からの コンビなのよ
Translated: <@RL,35,00>Those two have been a team<D3>ever since they enrolled here.

Original: <@RL,35,00>...じつは あたしも あいつらとは<CD>クサレえん なんだけどね<CF><D1>みとめたくないと 言うか<CD>なんと 言うか...
Translated: <@RL,35,00>...Actually, I go way back with them too,<D3>though we are not exactly friends.<CF><D1>I would rather not admit it,<D3>or something like that...

Original: <@RL,35,00>はじることは ないわ!<CF><D1>自分の 気持ちに しょうじきに<CD>なれば いいのよ!
Translated: <@RL,35,00>There is nothing to be ashamed of!<CF><D1>Just be honest about your feelings<D3>and you will be fine!

Original: <@RL,35,00>あの2人...<CD>何 バカなこと 言ってるんだか
Translated: <@RL,35,00>Those two...<D3>What nonsense are they talking about?

Original: <@RL,35,00>うちの たんにんの 先生<CF><D1>さいきん じゅぎょうにすら<CD>出てこないのよ!<CF><D1>これって しょくむたいまんよね!
Translated: <@RL,35,00>Our homeroom teacher.<CF><D1>Lately, she does not even<D3>show up for class!<CF><D1>That is downright dereliction of duty!

Original: <@RL,35,00>先生 そんなに コクエンが<CD>こわいのかしら?
Translated: <@RL,35,00>I wonder if the teacher is really<D3>that scared of Kokuen?

Original: <@RL,35,00>メイドすがたの ジャンヌ.ダルク!<CF><D1>おねがい コクエンの つぎは<CD>うちの たんにんを やっつけて!
Translated: <@RL,35,00>Joan of Arc in a maid outfit!<CF><D1>Please, after you deal with Kokuen,<D3>take down our homeroom teacher too!

Original: <@RL,35,00>コクエンのしはいが おわっても<CD>先生は あらわれない...
Translated: <@RL,35,00>Even after Kokuen's rule ended,<D3>the teacher still has not shown up...

Original: <@RL,2A,00>あの たんにん じゅぎょうに<CD>出てきても ざっしとか よんでて<CF><D1>しごと しないからなぁ...<CD>いても いなくても いっしょかも?
Translated: <@RL,2A,00>That homeroom teacher reads magazines<D3>even when she does come to class.<CF><D1>She does not do any work...<D3>Maybe it makes no difference whether she is here or not?

Original: <@RL,2A,00>そういや あの たんにん<CD>学校に 来ているのかな?<CF><D1>さいきん みかけないけど...
Translated: <@RL,2A,00>Come to think of it, is that homeroom teacher<D3>even coming to school?<CF><D1>I have not seen her lately...

Original: <@RL,2A,00>メイドすがたの ジャンヌ.ダルク<CF><D1>となリの子の 言うことは<CD>気にしないで いいからね
Translated: <@RL,2A,00>Joan of Arc in a maid outfit.<CF><D1>Do not worry about what the girl<D3>next to me says.

Original: <@RL,2A,00>あの たんにん 聞いた話によると<CF><D1>今 いなかに かえって<CD>はたけ たがやしてる らしいよ
Translated: <@RL,2A,00>According to what I heard, that homeroom teacher<CF><D1>went back to the countryside<D3>and is farming a field now.

Original: <@RL,2A,00>なんだ あんたらは?<CD>貝かけない かおだな...
Translated: <@RL,2A,00>Who are you guys?<D3>You have some unfamiliar faces...

Original: <@RL,2A,00>コクエンめ おれたち リバティ-ズの<CD>力を 思いしらせてやる!
Translated: <@RL,2A,00>Kokuen! We Liberty's will<D3>show you what we can do!

Original: <@RL,2A,00>メイドすがたの ジャンヌ.ダルクか<CF><D1>ウワサの通リ いや それいじょうに<CD>うつくしい...
Translated: <@RL,2A,00>Joan of Arc in a maid outfit?<CF><D1>She is as beautiful as the rumors said,<D3>maybe even more...

Original: <@RL,2A,00>おれたちだけで カメヤマを<CD>すくえなかったのは ザンネンだけど<CF><D1>ヘいわになって よかったよ
Translated: <@RL,2A,00>It is a shame we could not save Kameyama<D3>on our own,<CF><D1>but I am glad peace has returned.

Original: <@RL,2A,00>ん? てんこうせい か?
Translated: <@RL,2A,00>Hm? Are you a transfer student?

Original: <@RL,2A,00>リ-ダ-が 来てくれれば<CD>コクエンなんて おそれることはない
Translated: <@RL,2A,00>If our leader comes, there is no reason<D3>to be afraid of Kokuen.

Original: <@RL,2A,00>メイドすがたの ジャンヌ.ダルク<CF><D1>コクエンを みリょうしたと言うのも<CD>あながち ウソでは なさそうだな
Translated: <@RL,2A,00>Joan of Arc in a maid outfit.<CF><D1>They say she has charmed Kokuen,<D3>and it does not sound entirely untrue.

Original: <@RL,2A,00>コクエンは メイド少女に<CD>みリょうされたらしい<CF><D1>ホントかよ?
Translated: <@RL,2A,00>Apparently Kokuen was charmed by<D3>the maid girl.<CF><D1>Seriously?

Original: <@RL,35,00>あら あなた とんでもない時に<CD>来ちゃったわね かわいそうに
Translated: <@RL,35,00>Oh, you came at a terrible time.<D3>Poor thing.

Original: <@RL,35,00>カメヤマが かいほうされるのも<CD>近いわ...そんな気が するの
Translated: <@RL,35,00>I have a feeling it will not be long<D3>before Kameyama is liberated...

Original: <@RL,35,00>.........<CF><D1>.........ハッ<CF><D1>わたしが かわいさに 目がくらんで<CD>どうするのよ!?
Translated: <@RL,35,00>.........<CF><D1>.........Huh?<CF><D1>What am I doing, getting blinded by<D3>how cute she is!?

Original: <@RL,35,00>コクエンは メイド少女の かわいさに<CD>目がくらんで 敗北した らしいわ<CF><D1>バカよね~
Translated: <@RL,35,00>Apparently Kokuen lost because he was blinded<D3>by the maid girl's cuteness.<CF><D1>What an idiot~

Original: <@RL,35,00>そつぎょうした サメジマせんぱいや<CD>ひとつばしせんぱいたちが いれば<CF><D1>ここまで コクエンの すきに<CD>させることも なかったでしょうに
Translated: <@RL,35,00>If only graduates Samejima and<D3>Hitotsubashi were here,<CF><D1>they never would have let Kokuen<D3>do whatever he wanted around here.

Original: <@RL,35,00>コクエンのせいで 女子メダロット部も<CD>休部じょうたい...<CF><D1>ひとつばしせんぱい!<CD>もうしわけあリません~~~!!
Translated: <@RL,35,00>Because of Kokuen, the girls' Medarot Club<D3>is basically suspended...<CF><D1>Senpai Hitotsubashi!<D3>I am so sorry~~~!!

Original: <@RL,35,00>あなた つぎは 女子メダロット部の<CD>きゅうせいしゅに なってみない?
Translated: <@RL,35,00>Would you like to become the girls' Medarot Club's<D3>new savior?

Original: <@RL,35,00>メイド少女は カメヤマの<CD>せいとなのかしら?<CF><D1>もし そうなら 女子メダロット部に<CD>スカウトすベきよ!
Translated: <@RL,35,00>I wonder if the maid girl is a<D3>student from Kameyama?<CF><D1>If so, we should recruit her<D3>into the girls' Medarot Club!

Original: <@RL,2A,00>今にして 思えば ダメロット部は<CD>つよかったよなぁ...<CF><D1>コクエンも けっきょく リんたろうに<CD>勝てなかったんだから
Translated: <@RL,2A,00>Looking back, the Damelot Club<D3>was pretty strong...<CF><D1>Kokuen could not beat Rintaro in the end,<D3>after all.

Original: <@RL,2A,00>ウワサに 聞いたんだけどさ<CF><D1>元ダメロット部の サメジマせんぱいが<CD>きゅうこうしゃに つかまってるとか
Translated: <@RL,2A,00>I heard a rumor.<CF><D1>Apparently former Damelot Club member<D3>Samejima is being held by the school guards.

Original: <@RL,2A,00>っておいおい! あの人でも<CD>コクエンに 勝てなかったのか!?
Translated: <@RL,2A,00>Wait, seriously!? Even he could not<D3>beat Kokuen!?

Original: <@RL,2A,00>けっきょく あなたが 1番<CD>つよかったんですね~
Translated: <@RL,2A,00>So in the end, you were the strongest~<D3>

Original: <@RL,2A,00>けっきょく コクエンを たおしたのは<CD>リんたろうと<CF><D1>たまを先生と<CD>なぞの メイド少女らしい<CF><D1>メイドすがたの ジャンヌ.ダルク<CD>ちまたじゃ そう よばれてるそうだ
Translated: <@RL,2A,00>Apparently the ones who finally defeated Kokuen<D3>were Rintaro,<CF><D1>Teacher Tamao, and<D3>a mysterious maid girl.<CF><D1>Joan of Arc in a maid outfit<D3>is what people around here call her.

Original: <@RL,47,00>ここも いい いみで にぎやかに<CD>なリました あなたの おかげです<CF><D1><@LL,00,05>いい いみ なのかな?
Translated: <@RL,47,00>This place has gotten lively in a good way,<D3>thanks to you.<CF><D1><@LL,00,05>In a good way, I hope?

Original: <@RL,40,00>おれ 思うんだけどさ<CD>この こうしゃの方が<CF><D1>もくぞうの 今の こうしゃよリ<CD>新しく 貝えるんだけど...
Translated: <@RL,40,00>I was thinking...<D3>this school building could be<CF><D1>newly rebuilt instead of keeping<D3>this old wooden building...

Original: <@RL,40,00>なんだ なんだっ!?<CD>何が おこっているんだ!?
Translated: <@RL,40,00>What is going on!?<D3>What is happening!?

Original: <@RL,47,00>ん? コクエンさまに よばれたのか?<CD>とっとと コクエンさまの所ヘ 行け<CF><D1><@LL,00,05>(そうは いかないんだよなぁ<CD>リんたろうたちを たすけないと)
Translated: <@RL,47,00>What, did Lord Kokuen call for you?<D3>Get over to Lord Kokuen's place.<CF><D1><@LL,00,05>(I cannot do that...<D3>I have to save Rintaro and the others.)

Original: <@RL,47,00>リバティ-ズが せめてきたのか!?<CD>おのれ こしゃくな マネをッ!!<CF><D1>でも こわいから<CD>おとなしくしてよ~っと
Translated: <@RL,47,00>Liberty's have attacked!?<D3>How dare they pull a stunt like this!!<CF><D1>But I am scared, so<D3>I think I will just stay quiet~

Original: <@RL,40,00>そこの女は 気があらい<CD>むやみに 話かけない方がいいぞ
Translated: <@RL,40,00>That woman has a nasty temper.<D3>You would better not talk to her.

Original: <@RL,41,00>あんた かわいいかお してるじゃない<CF><D1>...気にくわないねぇ!
Translated: <@RL,41,00>You have a cute face, do you not?<CF><D1>...But I do not like you!

Original: <@RL,41,00>このさわぎは あんたの しわざかい?<CD>あじな マネを!
Translated: <@RL,41,00>Is this commotion your doing?<D3>Quite a stunt!

Original: <@RL,41,00>おぼえときなッ!!
Translated: <@RL,41,00>Remember that!!

Original: <@RL,47,00>リバティ-ズが せめてきただと!?
Translated: <@RL,47,00>Liberty's have attacked!?

Original: <@RL,47,00>もう ダメだあぁ~~!!
Translated: <@RL,47,00>We are doomed~~!!

Original: <@RL,47,00>にげるしかないな...
Translated: <@RL,47,00>We have no choice but to run...

Original: <@RL,01,04>こっちは だいじょうぶよ<CD><&BUF03>も 気をつけてね!
Translated: <@RL,01,04>We are fine here.<D3><&BUF03>Be careful too!

Original: <@RL,3D,00>たすけてくれて<CD>あリがとうございました
Translated: <@RL,3D,00>Thank you for helping me.<D3>I really appreciate it.

Original: <@RL,3F,00>いきなリ とじこめられて...<CD>何だっていうのよ いったい
Translated: <@RL,3F,00>I was suddenly locked up...<D3>What on earth is going on?

Original: <@RL,35,00>あ <&BUF03>くん...<CF><D1><@LL,00,07>センジュさん!?<CF><D1><@LL,00,06>センジュさんも さらわれてたのか<CF><D1><@RL,35,00>うん...学校のかえリに ヘビさんと<CD>タコさんに さらわれたの<CF><D1><@LL,00,05>...アカと アオだな<CF><D1><@LL,00,02>コクエンを たおせば<CD>みんな 家に かえれるから<CF><D1>ちょっと まってて!<CF><D1><@RL,35,00>...うん がんばってね
Translated: <@RL,35,00>Ah, <&BUF03>...<CF><D1><@LL,00,07>Senju!?<CF><D1><@LL,00,06>You were kidnapped too, Senju?<CF><D1><@RL,35,00>Yeah... On my way home from school,<D3>Snake and Octopus kidnapped me.<CF><D1><@LL,00,05>...Aka and Ao, huh.<CF><D1><@LL,00,02>If we defeat Kokuen,<D3>everyone can go home,<CF><D1>so hang on a little longer!<CF><D1><@RL,35,00>...Yeah. Good luck.

Original: <@RL,35,00>その...たすけてくれて あリがとう<CD>...がんばって ね
Translated: <@RL,35,00>Um... thanks for rescuing me.<D3>...Do your best.

Original: <@RL,3D,00>「はなよめこうほ」ですって?<CD>じょうだんじゃ ないわ!<CF><D1>わたくしの リそうは<CD>もっと も~っと 高いですのよ!
Translated: <@RL,3D,00>"Bride candidate"?<D3>You have got to be kidding!<CF><D1>My ideal is<D3>much, much higher than that!

Original: <@RL,03,03>ものすごい らんせんだな<CD>どこに だれがいるか わからないぞ
Translated: <@RL,03,03>What an incredible mess.<D3>You cannot tell who is where.

Original: <@RL,4D,02>ここは オレに まかせな!<CF><D1>てめぇにゃ てめぇの やるベきことが<CD>あるだろうがッ!!<CF><D1><@LL,00,07>わ わかったッ!
Translated: <@RL,4D,02>Leave this to me!<CF><D1>You have your own job<D3>to take care of!!<CF><D1><@LL,00,07>Y-yes, sir!

Original: <@RL,4B,00>みはリに 立たされてるクマ<CF><D1>女メダの 元部長よリ<CD>こわいでクマよ
Translated: <@RL,4B,00>This bear has been put on guard duty.<CF><D1>I am scarier than the former<D3>girls' Medarot Club president, bear!

Original: <@RL,4C,00>こいつらは あちきが<CD>みはってるでやんすよ!
Translated: <@RL,4C,00>I'm keeping watch over these guys<D3>for you, yarr!

Original: <@RL,2A,00>リバティ-ズの 勝利は<CD>きまったようなものさ!
Translated: <@RL,2A,00>Liberty's victory is<D3>practically assured!

Original: <@RL,2A,00>コクエンは きゅこうしゃの 外に<CD>にげたらしいぞっ!
Translated: <@RL,2A,00>I hear Kokuen escaped<D3>outside the school!

Original: <@RL,2A,00>いつまでも コクエンの すきには<CD>させないぞ!
Translated: <@RL,2A,00>We will not let Kokuen<D3>have his way forever!

Original: <@RL,35,00>なっ なによ コイツ<CD>こないでっ!!
Translated: <@RL,35,00>W-what is with this guy?<D3>Stay away!!

Original: <@RL,35,00>あリがとう たすかったわ<CD>あなた つよいのね
Translated: <@RL,35,00>Thank you! You saved me.<D3>You are strong, are you not?

Original: <@RL,FF,30>マスタ-の方を ねらっている?<CD>そんな バカな!!
Translated: <@RL,FF,30>They are targeting the Master?<D3>That cannot be!!

Original: <@RL,FF,30>あリがとうございました
Translated: <@RL,FF,30>Thank you very much.

Original: <@LL,00,02>こい! ぼくが あいてだっ!!
Translated: <@LL,00,02>Come on! I'm your opponent!!

Original: <@LL,00,06>こんなところにも!
Translated: <@LL,00,06>Here too!

Original: <@LL,00,02>ぼくが あいてだ かかってこい!
Translated: <@LL,00,02>I'm your opponent! Come at me!

Original: <@LL,00,07>あ あれは ミズチ!<CF><D1>もうじゅうメダロットと<CD>たたかっている!<CF><D1>たすけに きてくれたのか!?
Translated: <@LL,00,07>Ah, that is Mizuchi!<CF><D1>He is fighting the beast Medarots!<D3><CF><D1>Did he come to help us!?

Original: <@LL,00,05>たすけに 行きたいけど<CD>あそこまでは 行けないや<CF><D1>でも どうして こんな所にいるんだ?
Translated: <@LL,00,05>I want to go help, but<D3>I cannot get all the way over there.<CF><D1>But why is he here?

Original: <@RL,0F,00>おお <&BUF03><CD>3たくクイズでも やってみるか?<*04>
Translated: <@RL,0F,00>Oh, <&BUF03><D3>want to try a three-choice quiz?<*04>

Original: <@RL,0F,02>そうか それじゃ また こんどな
Translated: <@RL,0F,02>I see. Well, maybe next time.

Original: <@RL,0F,01>早おしじゃからな<CD>そのあたリ 気をつけるがいい
Translated: <@RL,0F,01>It is a speed quiz,<D3>so keep that in mind.

Original: <@RL,0C,01>やあ いらっしゃい<*05>
Translated: <@RL,0C,01>Hi there! Welcome!<*05>

Original: <@RL,0C,01>ちょうしは どうだい?
Translated: <@RL,0C,01>How's it going?

Original: <@LL,00,07>ヒカルさん こんな 夜おそくまで<CD>バイトですか!?<CF><D1><@RL,0C,02>コンビニは 24時間えいぎょうだしね<CF><D1><@LL,00,06>だからって 24時間ずっと<CD>ヒカルさんが やるひつようは...<CF><D1><@RL,0C,02>いいんだよ とくに することないしね<*05>
Translated: <@LL,00,07>Hikaru, you're working this late!?<D3><CF><D1><@RL,0C,02>The convenience store is open 24 hours<CF><D1><@LL,00,06>That doesn't mean you have to work<D3>24 hours straight...<CF><D1><@RL,0C,02>It's fine. I don't have anything else to do.<*05>

Original: <@RL,0C,01>ロボトルでも してみるかい?<*04>
Translated: <@RL,0C,01>Want to have a Robattle?<*04>

Original: <@RL,0C,01>それじゃ はじめようか
Translated: <@RL,0C,01>All right, let's begin.

Original: <@LL,00,05>よかったんですか? しごと中に<CF><D1><@RL,0C,02>いいんだよ<CD>とくに することないしね<*05>
Translated: <@LL,00,05>Isn't that a little much while you're working?<CF><D1><@RL,0C,02>It's fine.<D3>I don't have anything else to do.<*05>

Original: <@LL,00,05>それって 店の しょうひんなんじゃ?<CF><D1><@RL,0C,02>いいんだよ<CD>とくに することないしね<*05>
Translated: <@LL,00,05>Isn't that store merchandise?<CF><D1><@RL,0C,02>It's fine.<D3>I don't have anything else to do.<*05>

Original: <@LL,00,05>こたえに なってませんよ
Translated: <@LL,00,05>That doesn't answer my question.

Original: <@RL,0C,00>それじゃ また こんどね
Translated: <@RL,0C,00>See you next time.

Original: <@RL,FF,D8>おぅ! ひさしぶリやないか!<CF><D1><@RL,FF,D9>オレっちたちと ひとしょうぶ<CD>してみねぇか?<*04>
Translated: <@RL,FF,D8>Oh! Long time no see!<CF><D1><@RL,FF,D9>How about a match<D3>with us?<*04>

Original: <@RL,FF,D8>そうこな あかんで!<CF><D1><@RL,FF,D9>手かげん なしで 行くぜっ!
Translated: <@RL,FF,D8>That's more like it!<CF><D1><@RL,FF,D9>I'm going all out!

Original: <@RL,FF,D8>おもろかったで!<CF><D1><@RL,FF,D9>また 来いよな!
Translated: <@RL,FF,D8>That was fun!<CF><D1><@RL,FF,D9>Come back again!

Original: <@RL,FF,D8>なんや ザンネンやなぁ...<CF><D1><@RL,FF,D9>また こんどな!
Translated: <@RL,FF,D8>Aw, that's too bad...<CF><D1><@RL,FF,D9>Maybe next time!

Original: <@RL,4A,01>きゅうこうしゃで みつけたこれ<CD>あげるだぜェ!
